textbook_summary: SVT may have wide QRS with bundle block.
implementation_basis: Existing LeftBundleBlockReference authored electrode morphology, excluding its Mobitz-II schedule
invariants: Same overlapping retrograde P as narrow SVT
Left-bundle QRS and secondary ST/T share existing electrode tables
No dropped beats copied from the original LBBB demonstration schedule
Left/right simultaneous and orphan flags rejected atomically
limitations: 140ms QRS is an authored illustration choice, not a textbook measurement
No rate-dependent aberrancy, reentry or clinical pump impairment model
No episode onset/termination or AVNRT/AVRT differentiation
